concepts.why: The patient presented with a left cervical lesion, which is a common site for melanoma, and subsequent lymph node metastasis and locoregional recurrence with skin metastasis are consistent with melanoma.
The Breslow depth and mitotic rate are consistent with nodular melanoma, but the absence of ulceration is not typical.
The patient has fewer than 50 nevi, which is consistent with superficial spreading melanoma, but the Breslow depth and mitotic rate are not typical.
The patient has phototype 3 skin, which is consistent with lentigo maligna melanoma, but the Breslow depth and mitotic rate are not typical.
The patient has a lesion on the left cervical area, which is not a typical site for acral lentiginous melanoma.
